2.translation: Since v0.50.0, sequence layout, feature lanes, tracks and guides use the revised API. Update existing scripts one layer at a time. Use ⟦shared:0⟧ for sequence order and orientation, ⟦shared:1⟧ for feature lanes and ⟦shared:2⟧ to share a band across quantitative layers.

3.translation: [Full migration table and replacement calls](⟦shared:0⟧) · [Browse functions by purpose](⟦shared:1⟧)

6.translation: Bookmarks for plotting entries, cases and figure anchors remain usable. Browse the [plotting guide](⟦shared:0⟧) by figure or [data and operations](⟦shared:1⟧) by task.

8.translation: - Replace ⟦shared:0⟧ and ⟦shared:1⟧ with ⟦shared:2⟧ and ⟦shared:3⟧ respectively. Pass the same layer data. [Feature presets](⟦shared:4⟧)

9.translation: - Replace ⟦shared:0⟧ with ⟦shared:1⟧. Set the placement policy with ⟦shared:2⟧, control long labels with ⟦shared:3⟧, and select the feature layer with ⟦shared:4⟧ when needed. [Feature labels](⟦shared:5⟧)

10.translation: - Replace ⟦shared:0⟧ with ⟦shared:1⟧. For lanes, use ⟦shared:2⟧ to set the starting position and direction. [Offsets](⟦shared:3⟧) · [Feature lanes](⟦shared:4⟧)

11.translation: - Declare the physical band with ⟦shared:0⟧ and pass ⟦shared:1⟧ on each quantitative layer. The former ⟦shared:2⟧ placed the band. The layer’s ⟦shared:3⟧ now adjusts its data by stacking, dodging or nudging. [Track bands](⟦shared:4⟧) · [Quantitative layers](⟦shared:5⟧)
